sample_unit: synthetic oncology case notes (physician and patient letters generated)

links.outcome: Readability and understandability of AI-generated patient letters
links.effect: Mean Flesch Reading Ease 73.3 (seventh-grade reading level); PEMAT-P understandability score above 80%.
links.quote: Patient-directed letters achieved a mean Flesch Reading Ease score of 73.3 (seventh-grade reading level) and a PEMAT-P score above 80%, indicating high understandability.

unlisted_practices: Structured, iteratively developed prompt templates trained on sample cases to generate physician and patient letters

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT generating clinical consultation letters and patient letters from synthetic oncology case notes, evaluated offline by oncologists and consumer reviewers.
